title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 trusted backend service 時的資料庫存取與 transaction boundary。Phase A Access Model 已完成 runtime verification：service identity、PostgreSQL object privilege 與 RLS 可被獨立觀察，且 SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE least-privilege boundary 已驗證。Phase B Operation Model 與 Phase C Transaction Model 尚待驗證。
flow: Phase A VERIFIED: backend service identity → PostgreSQL object privilege / RLS → Native Data API CRUD. Phase B PLANNED: Edge Function → RPC → SECURITY INVOKER / DEFINER + EXECUTE boundary. Phase C PLANNED: compare separate Data API DELETE + INSERT with one atomic RPC operation under forced INSERT failure. Phase D optional/deferred.
